description: Starts a MisarSEO site crawl/audit from startUrl. Returns `{ jobId, auditId }` (the same id twice) with HTTP 202; the crawl then runs in the background — poll it with get_site_audit_status. FREE of SEO credits, but it CONSUMES ONE of the organization's monthly audits from its plan quota (a spent quota is a plan-limit error), so confirm with the user before starting one and never start one speculatively.

maxPages.description: Most pages to crawl (at most 5000). Omit for the service default of 50.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

renderJs.description: Run each page's JavaScript before analysing it — needed for client-rendered sites. Defaults to false.

startUrl.description: http(s) URL the crawl starts from, usually the site's home page.

strategy.description: Which pages get a Lighthouse run. Defaults to auto.

name: start_site_audit
